messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy started: `green-pool-edge-v3` -> rolling to eu-west shards (traffic-split=10%). Deploy latency probe scheduled.
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: Paging on-call: irene (eu-sre) — high error rate in eu-west from canary group. Pager: P1
irene: I’m on it. pulling up metrics and the canary logs now.
drew: Saw alerts too — spike of 503s around 3182468088, looks like ~7% of requests. Not all customers.
irene: Can anyone confirm if the new edge-config contains the egress pinning tweak? I see a mix of routes.
sanjay: yep the rollout included the new `egress_pin_v2` rule. I pushed the rule to green pool yesterday.
leo: Metrics: 5xx rate up to 12% for traffic routed to edge shard eu-w-03. Other shards normal.
irene: Logs from eu-w-03 show backend connection resets to model-proxy: `error=upstream_reset before headers` repeated.
drew: That suggests a mismatch between the model-proxy TLS profile and the new edge TLS config; connections are being dropped mid-handshake.
sanjay: Hmm — the green pool has slightly different SNI mapping (hostname suffix `.svc.internal` vs `.svc.int`). If traffic is sticky to certain backends because of prefix caching, that could explain the shard-local spike.
leo: Customer impact: approx 1.2k failed requests/min at peak, affecting ~18 active API keys (top affected tenants listed in ops dashboard).
customer-ops: Seeing live customer DMs about degraded responses from EU region — flagging priority outreach for top 3 tenants.
irene: Ok immediate mitigation plan: 1) flip traffic-split back to 0% to stop green pool traffic for now. 2) disable `egress_pin_v2` feature flag if traffic-split flip doesn’t converge. 3) start rollback of green pool if needed.
drew: I'll try the traffic-split flip now via rollout service.

```bash
# rolloutctl
rolloutctl set-split --region eu-west --green 0 --blue 100 --id=3182468100
```

deploy-bot: Executing `rolloutctl` (user=drew). Change submitted.
leo: I see split change in the control plane, but dataplane reports some lingering sticky sessions to eu-w-03 — TTLs on connection reuse may keep traffic flowing for ~30s-90s.
irene: Good point. Start feature-flag kill if lingering persists. Sanjay, can you be ready to flip the flag?
sanjay: Ready. Kill flag endpoint: `featureflag.set('egress_pin_v2', false)`

irene: Doing coordinated update: I'll hold the prod rollback decision till we see effect from flag kill. Also notifying on-call infra for potential proxy restarts.

deploy-bot: Observability event: split-change applied at 3182468142. Green percent -> 0.
leo: 60s after change — 5xx rate dropped to ~3% but still above baseline for eu-w-03.
irene: Go ahead and flip the flag now, sanjay.
sanjay: Flipping flag.

```python
# featureflag API
featureflag.set('egress_pin_v2', False, actor='sanjay', reason='mitigate eu-w-03 503 spike')
```

sanjay: Flag acknowledged, propagation started.
leo: 2m after flag flip: 5xx now ~0.6% and healthy across shards. Connection reset logs stop.
customer-ops: Notifying top 3 tenants that incident mitigation is in effect; will follow up if any residual errors.
irene: Great. Next: we should still roll back the green pool deploy to be safe and trigger a controlled restart of model-proxy on eu-w-03 to clear stuck connections.
drew: Rolling back green pool now.

```bash
# rollback
rolloutctl rollback --pool green --region eu-west --id=3182468100
```

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by drew at 3182468185. Estimated complete ~60s.
leo: Rollback finished, metrics are stable and within SLOs. No more 503 spikes.
sanjay: I'll schedule a config diff and a canary rehearsal for the egress pin change — seems the SNI variant needs alignment with proxy TLS.
irene: Handoff: I'm going offline in 15m. Leo, can you take follow-up for postmortem and config diff? Drew will stay for infra restarts.
leo: On it. Will open an incident doc and link the config diff + reproducer, and runbook steps to avoid sticky-session TTL issues.
drew: I'll coordinate proxy restart with infra tomorrow morning in low-traffic window.

customer-ops: Customers informed. No escalations so far. We'll prepare targeted outreach for the 3 tenants impacted.
irene: Summary for the record: cause=egress-pin config + SNI mismatch in green-edge leading to sticky routing to eu-w-03 and upstream TLS resets. Mitigation=traffic-split -> 0, feature-flag kill `egress_pin_v2=false`, rollback green pool, restart proxy. Impact=brief 503 spike ~1.2k req/min, ~18 tenants affected, no data loss. Next actions: postmortem, config alignment, canary tweak (lower initial split), add dataplane check for SNI consistency.
leo: I'll draft the postmortem and assign action items. tagging this thread for follow-up: #runbooks/edge-rollouts.
irene: Thanks all. Closing page at 3182468225 :thumbsup:
